correctness.rationale: TARGET route: draft proves first horn for entire planar subluminal family. Profile reduction to A-minimal equation with A=diag(1-v^2,1,1) and scaling to standard minimal-graph equation is standard and correct; Bernstein affine conclusion for n=3 entire C^2 profiles is correct. Quadratic null identity S=-2(q.xi)g0/(1+Q), hence vanishing on g0-cone, was verified symbolically and on 200 random g0-null covectors (max|S|=4.4e-15) by re-running null_check.py. Lorentzian signature (-,+,+,+), g0*m=I, det=-(1+Q), linearizing congruence on 500 backgrounds verified by re-running metric_check.py. Constant-coefficient reduction to Box_y plus null quadratic and analytic cubic remainder, then invocation of Klainerman/Christodoulou/Sogge/Hormander 3D null-form global existence with N>=8, bounded energy and (1+t)^-1 decay, is a correct use of cited peer-reviewed theorems; timelikeness persistence follows from small |dU|. Minor mislabel of Q_{munu} does not affect vanishing-on-cone criterion.

originality.rationale: TARGET headline fails originality: global nonlinear stability of flat timelike planes in 3+1 with bounded energy and (1+t)^-1 decay is already the Allen-Andersson-Isenberg flat-plane theorem (arbitrary codimension, n>=2, q>=1), which substantively implies the draft's affine subluminal traveling-plane subfamily since the graph of r(x1-vt)+b2x2+b3x3+c is a flat timelike plane (tilt/boost of trivial plane). AAI assumes the same H^N compact data, proves the same M1/M2 boundedness and N-decay (1+t)^-(n-1)/2, and uses the same divergence plus null structure. The Bernstein A-minimal reduction for |c|<1 and affine conclusion were already published in Liu-Zhou 1903.04129 Sec.1 (Eqs.1.3-1.4), which explicitly attributes |c|<1 flat-plane stability to Allen et al. Hence the combination is a corollary/repackaging of a known stronger fact, not a new claim; snippet absence or timestamp cannot establish priority.

value.rationale: As a TARGET first-horn resolution, the statement itself is independently valuable: stability with sharp linear 3D decay for the natural subluminal membrane traveling-wave family, motivated before computation, not a type error, vacuity, cheap mismatch, direct lookup, or arbitrary parameter fact. An exact global-regularity-plus-decay theorem for a natural geometric PDE object with sharp rate is worth retrieving even though narrow, and no general census is required. Value PASSES; overall verdict still REJECT because originality FAILS.

checked_sources: Allen-Andersson-Isenberg math/0512036 (JHDE 2006): timelike minimal submanifolds arbitrary n>=2/q>=1 close to flat plane; Sec.3 bootstrap M1/M2 bounded, N-decay (1+t)^-(n-1)/2; Sec.4 null condition; directly dominates draft affine-plane family.
Lindblad math/0210056 (PAMS 2004): membrane/minimal-surface-in-Minkowski small-data global existence via null/double-null condition; engine cited by draft, scope stated for trivial background.

Liu-Zhou 1903.04129 (IMRN 2024): same |c|<1 traveling reduction to minimal-surface equation, Bernstein affine conclusion, stability of flat planes attributed to Allen et al.; Thm 1.1 proves only luminal c=1 case in 1+(2+1).
Abbrescia-Wong 1903.03553 (Forum Math Pi 2020): stability of finite-extent simple (null) planar pulses in d>=3; different speed/profile class from draft affine subluminal planes.
Yan-Li 2111.08877 (JGA 2024): asymptotic stability of stationary hyperplane us=A.x+B for 2<=M<=7; covers only v=0 subcase, not traveling v!=0 family with Klainerman decay.
Brendle 2002 and Milbredt 2008 thesis considered as citation leads: small-data/local flat-plane background results; dominated by AAI for this audit and not separately decisive.

broader_coverage.evidence: AAI proves small-data global existence near any flat timelike plane for n>=2 and arbitrary codimension q>=1 (hence scalar q=1, n=3), with bounded high energies and pointwise decay (1+t)^-(n-1)/2; Brendle/Lindblad are weaker special cases of the same flat-plane program.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Draft's family (affine graphs with |v|<1) is a strict subset of AAI flat timelike planes via fixed ambient Lorentz rotation/boost; AAI hypotheses admit the same compact H^N data and its conclusions match bounded Klainerman energy plus sharp (1+t)^-1 decay, so the broader theorem exhaustively covers the headline as a special case.
broader_coverage.search: Searched stronger flat-plane stability theorems: Allen-Andersson-Isenberg general-codimension, Brendle hypersurface, Lindblad membrane double-null, Abbrescia-Wong d>=3 pulse stability.

claim_vs_prior_implication.evidence: AAI abstract plus Sec.3 estimates (M1/M2 bounded, N2 decay) match draft (2); Liu-Zhou Sec.1 Eqs.1.2-1.4 publish the identical A=diag(1-c^2,1,1) reduction and affine conclusion for |c|<1 and cite Allen et al. for that case's stability.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Even though AAI does not write draft's traveling-plane notation verbatim, its result substantively implies the headline after a fixed linear/Lorentz change of variables that draft itself constructs; prior need not state the headline verbatim to defeat originality, so this is recomputation plus corollary repackaging and originality FAILS.
claim_vs_prior_implication.search: Compared draft Theorem hypotheses/conclusions literally against AAI flat-plane theorem and Liu-Zhou Sec.1 reduction: object, data size, timelikeness, energy boundedness, decay rate.

equivalent_formulations.evidence: Checked tilted-plane/Lorentz-boost equivalence, Born-Infeld scalar, timelike extremal/minimal hypersurface, membrane graph, constant-gradient background, g0-null and Q00/Qab encodings; AAI vector system with q=1 reduces to draft scalar equation and Lindblad Q00 formulation matches draft quadratic symbol factorization.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Rewording zero background as tilted traveling plane via fixed linear map y=Ly does not create a new theorem because null condition S=0 on g0-cone is preserved under that congruence and the cited null-form theorem applies identically; synonymous notation and dual matrix encodings therefore do not escape AAI/Lindblad coverage.
equivalent_formulations.search: Searched equivalent wordings: flat tilted plane vs traveling wave, Lorentz-boosted background, Born-Infeld scalar, membrane Q00 null forms, g0-null cone factorization.

exact_database_or_table.evidence: No exact-parameter table or database lists draft's (v,r,b2,b3) affine decay as a separate record; Milbredt thesis gives local/causal theory only, not the global decay table; official census/database search returned only the general flat-plane theorems above.
exact_database_or_table.reasoning: Absence of an exact table entry does not establish priority because theorem-level coverage by AAI already subsumes every such parameter tuple; the claim is not a new database value but a corollary instance, so the database check supports rather than rescues originality.
exact_database_or_table.search: Searched specialist theses, membrane databases, and exact affine-parameter tables for subluminal planar traveling-wave stability records.
